_comment.about: corporate/corporate/nextjs is the Next.js half of corporate_sdk, the company pages. Since 1.2.0 (Ray, 2026-09-11 20:44Z, of /about: "we have no way to get here and its so disconnected to the rest of the site") every page here - /about, /team, /legal, /legal/<id> - awaits base_sdk >= 1.47.0's resolveSiteFrame({plans: [], session, dataMode}) (components/custom/landing/site-frame.ts) and sits in base's SiteFrame (components/custom/site-frame.tsx: the home SDK's header with its registered menu, its theme and its footer - the sections it marked frame: true) when SiteFrameLayout.registered is true, and in this SDK's own CompanyFrame / LegalFrame otherwise, so a shell composed without a home landing renders exactly as 1.1.0 did; the home SDK opts in by marking its theme and footer sections, and this SDK never imports one. Also since 1.2.0 load-legal-doc.ts's loadLegalDoc(slug) mirrors base_sdk 1.45.0's listPublicTerms() rule per slug: the backend wins with an enabled document, and when it answers nothing for the slug the bundled data/legal/<slug>.md page is the document in any data mode that bundles the folder (bundledLegalDoc; a shell with no folder answers what it did), so the slugs the 1.45.0 index lists on a hybrid shell whose backend publishes nothing no longer 404 on their own page. Floors: base_sdk >= 1.47.0 (the site frame), base_sdk >= 1.45.0 (app/actions/base/legal.ts listing the bundled slugs the document page now answers). Since 1.1.0 (Ray, 2026-09-10 22:14Z: corporate_sdk owns the company pages - legal, about, team - as renderers, with content from the shell's data/ folder on local / hybrid shells) it installs app/about/page.tsx and app/team/page.tsx: /about renders the shell's data/about.md (base_sdk >= 1.35.0's readSiteData("about"), markdown parsed by components/custom/company/markdown-parser.ts and rendered as elements by markdown.tsx - a small safe subset, never HTML set from a string) and, under it, the home SDK's cards for the page through base_sdk >= 1.38.0's pageSectionsFor("about") (components/custom/landing/landing-page.ts; PageSectionMeta.page on page-sections.ts - Supacharge's founder card is lms_sdk 1.27.0's lms-founder-section.tsx), drawn by components/custom/company/company-sections.tsx with the PageSectionProps a landing section gets; /team renders data/team.json (readSiteData("team"): name, role, optional photo, optional links) as the card grid components/custom/company/team-grid.tsx plus pageSectionsFor("team"). Both sit in components/custom/company/company-frame.tsx (the host's PLATFORM_NAME linking home, the company links, base's FooterChromeRow with the Legal group) and take their titles from company-pages.ts (COMPANY_PAGES, the words About and Team - the only words this SDK owns here, as base owns Legal) through buildPageMetadata; with neither data nor a registered section each draws one neutral line (COMPANY_EMPTY_STATE) and still answers 200. The legal fallback: load-legal-doc.ts's loadLegalDoc / loadLegalIndex read data/legal/<slug>.md (siteLegalDocs) when hasSiteData("legal") and the shell is local or no tenant base URL resolves (resolveTenantBaseUrl); a hybrid shell with a backend keeps reading the backend. Floors: base_sdk >= 1.38.0 (landing-page.ts pageSectionsFor, page-sections.ts PageSectionMeta.page), >= 1.35.0 (lib/site-data/read-site-data.ts, lib/site-data/kinds.ts), >= 1.37.0 (the legal seam, as 1.0.0). No top-level site_data requires are declared: for the company pages every kind is optional and an absent file is the empty state (the home block's own requires apply only where corporate_sdk is home). In 1.0.0 the LEGAL pages only. Ray, 2026-09-10: "supa has no terms pages or about page"; asked where they belong, "legal pages are not in corporate sdk?" and "you should look at the dart side if they are not there yet" - on the Dart side corporate/corporate/dart (corporate_sdk 1.2.0) owns TermPage / PolicyPage at /term and /policy and every composition with auth_sdk includes it, so this half mirrors that ownership: it installs app/legal/page.tsx (the index of the shell's published legal documents) and app/legal/[id]/page.tsx (one document; 404 when missing or disabled), both server components with no "use client" (the first HTML carries the words; generateMetadata takes the document's title through base_sdk's buildPageMetadata), the renderer components/custom/legal/legal-doc.tsx (LegalDoc, normaliseLegalDoc, LegalDocView: title + the body as text with whitespace kept at prose width - the way rokct.ai's hand-rolled app/legal/[id]/page.tsx renders it), the frame components/custom/legal/legal-frame.tsx (the host's PLATFORM_NAME linking home, the content, and base_sdk's FooterChromeRow carrying the Legal link group built from the same documents), the guest read app/actions/corporate/legal.ts getPublicTerm(name) (frappe.client.get on doctype "Terms and Conditions" through base_sdk's platform gateway with no credentials, mirroring rokct.ai's TermsService.getSystemTerm; null with no backend) and the ONE seam the pages read through, components/custom/legal/load-legal-doc.ts: loadLegalDoc(slug) and loadLegalIndex(). The list comes from base_sdk >= 1.37.0's app/actions/base/legal.ts listPublicTerms() and the links from its components/custom/landing/legal-links.ts (legalFooterLinks, legalDocHref, LEGAL_DOCTYPE, LEGAL_ROUTE), so the footer row these pages draw is the row a home SDK's footer draws once it passes FooterChromeConfig.links - base carries the links and the read, this SDK the pages. Composed into every Next.js shell with auth (hosting, supacharge, rokctapp templates in the-rokct-protocol core/utils/frappe/composer), never as the home SDK (home_sdk false) of those product shells; since 1.4.0 it IS the home SDK of every local-data site, through its "home" block (see the home comment), and that block is inert wherever another SDK is home. Ray, 2026-09-10 22:14Z: corporate_sdk owns the company pages (legal, about, team) as renderers, with content from the shell's data/ folder on local / hybrid shells - base 1.35.0 adds that server-only reader, and corporate_sdk 1.1.0 adds the about / team pages and the data/ fallback inside loadLegalDoc / loadLegalIndex without touching the pages. No dependencies of its own (react, next and base's installs), no integrations: the routes are file-convention pages. tests/test_manifest.py holds the installs, the floors, that every entry module is directive-free, that the document page 404s a missing or disabled document, and that nothing rendered carries placeholder words. Since 1.4.1 the local-data site footer (components/custom/site/site-footer-section.tsx) passes FooterChromeConfig.siteName (data/site.json name) and no copyrightHolder, so base_sdk >= 1.54.0's row ends `© <year> <site name> · Built with ♥ by ROKCT` (Ray, 2026-10-31: "all site will be copyright sitename then built with love (as heart) by ROKCT"); floor base_sdk >= 1.54.0 (siteName). Since 1.4.2 components/custom/site/site-fonts.ts loads the seven site faces through next/font/local from the bundled woff2 files in components/custom/site/fonts/ (with OFL.txt) instead of next/font/google, so the build makes no request to Google Fonts: the next/font/google fetch failed southriver-web's Vercel production build on main 46cf377, as it did supacharge-web's and polaris-web's (polaris_sdk 1.8.1). Same --cs-font-* variables and siteFontClasses(); no floor moves. Since 1.5.0 the local-data renderer draws base_sdk 1.59.0's render fields (Ray, 2026-11-01: "south river site doesnt have what we discussed yet" - the South River render he approved): a bottle's `labels` roll round it one at a time and a label's `mark` is a monogram; the water stops in the neck and drops form and run down every bottle (reduced motion: first label, drops caught part-way); a pricing tier's `fine` line, its `art` drawn the card's full height and its `slider` (components/custom/site/site-pricing-slider.client.tsx, words from site-price.ts) with a running total; data/site.json `header.wordmark: false` draws the header logo image alone and `footer.logo` replaces the type wordmark in the footer, masked to the brand text colour. floor base_sdk >= 1.59.0.

_comment.home: corporate_sdk 1.4.0 (Ray, 2026-10-31: "corporate can be home sdk"; corporate_sdk is the home SDK of ALL local-data sites). Applies only in a shell whose composer.json flags corporate_sdk "home_sdk": true (the Next.js installer's "home" block, The-Rokct-Protocol sdk_installer_base.py). It owns app/page.tsx (a redirect to base_sdk's /landing) and fills base_sdk's landing registries from the shell's data/ folder: hero copy and hero form (the data hero, handed over as HeroConfig.formData, base_sdk >= 1.53.0), header menu, site metadata, a null plans query, and page sections - the theme (order -2, frame), twelve numbered slots that draw data/sections.json after its hero (order 10 + i) and the footer (order 95, frame). Its site_data.requires (theme, site, sections) fail a local build that lacks them (base_sdk >= 1.53.0 generate.mjs reads the home block). Everywhere else corporate_sdk installs the company pages only, as before.
